SELECT 
  s.id as store_id, 
  s.wc_user, 
  s.wc_pass, 
  s.drive_folder_id, 
  s.default_status 
FROM webhook_channels wc 
JOIN stores s ON wc.store_id = s.id 
WHERE (wc.channel_id = '{{ $json.headers["x-goog-channel-id"] }}' 
   OR wc.channel_id LIKE '{{ $json.headers["x-goog-channel-id"].split("-")[0] }}%')
  AND s.drive_folder_id = '{{ $json.headers["x-goog-channel-token"] }}' 
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO processing_queue (store_id, folder_id, folder_name, drive_folder_id, default_status)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.store_id }}',
  '{{ $json.folder_id }}',
  '{{ $json.folder_name.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.drive_folder_id }}',
  '{{ $json.default_status }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (store_id, folder_id) DO NOTHING;

UPDATE processing_queue
SET status = CASE 
        WHEN retry_count >= 9 THEN 'failed' 
        ELSE 'pending' 
    END,
    retry_count = retry_count + 1,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE status = 'processing'
  AND updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '3 minutes';

parameters.query:
UPDATE processing_queue
SET status = 'processing', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = (
  SELECT id FROM processing_queue
  WHERE status = 'pending'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM processing_queue WHERE status = 'processing'
  )
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
RETURNING *;

const allResponses = $input.all();
const meta = $('Split Per Image1').first().json; // product metadata is identical on every item

const allUrls = allResponses.flatMap(item => item.json.urls || []);

const payload = {
  title: meta.title,
  description: meta.description,
  short_description: meta.short_description,
  categories: meta.categories,
  sku: meta.sku,
  permalink: meta.permalink,
  attributes: meta.attributes,
  tags: meta.tags,
  price: meta.price,
  images: allUrls.map(src => ({ src })),
  queue_id: meta.queue_id,
  folderId: meta.folderId,
  folderName: meta.folderName,
  store_id: meta.store_id,
  drive_folder_id: meta.drive_folder_id,
  default_status: meta.default_status
};

return [{ json: payload }];

messageValues.message:
Output ONLY raw JSON. Do NOT use markdown code blocks (no ``` or ```json). No explanations, no comments. Use "" or [] or null for missing data. SCHEMA: { "title": "", "description": "", "short_description": "", "permalink": "", "categories": [], "tags": [], "price": null, "attributes": [] } TITLE: Extract the FULL 'optimized title' verbatim, exactly as written, including all text after every comma. The title ends only at the line break that precedes the description paragraph — do not stop at the first comma, do not shorten it, and do not treat comma-separated phrases as separate items. If no optimized title exists, extract the entire main file title in the same way: full text, verbatim, up to the line break. Example: Source: "Patina Brass Towel Bar, Handcrafted Brass Kitchen Towel Rail, Handmade Vintage Brass Bathroom Towel Bar" Correct output: "Patina Brass Towel Bar, Handcrafted Brass Kitchen Towel Rail, Handmade Vintage Brass Bathroom Towel Bar" Wrong output: "Patina Brass Towel Bar" ← truncated, this is NOT acceptable DESCRIPTION: Include ALL descriptive text, marketing copy, and features. DO NOT summarize or omit.Format as clean HTML: Wrap intro text in a

tag. Format distinct features/specs as

  • within a
      . SHORT DESCRIPTION & PERMALINK: Brief 1-2 sentence product teaser. URL-friendly slug for the product CATEGORY RULES: Pick exactly one category from the closed list that matches the PRODUCT ITSELF. Never output a category not in the list. Never repeat the list back. VALID CATEGORIES (closed list — no other value allowed): ["Bathroom Sinks", "Bathroom Faucets", "Bathtubs", "Wall-Mounted Mirrors", "Bathroom Mirrors", "Bathroom Wall Sconces", "Bathroom accessories", "Hand Towel Rings", "Shelving", "Shower Rods", "Shower systems", "Shower head", "Soap Dispensers and Dishes", "Toilet Brush Holders", "Toilet Paper Holders", "Towel Bars and Hooks", "Towel Racks", "Waste Bins", "Towel warmers", "Kitchen Sinks", "Kitchen Faucets", "Kitchen Lighting", "Pot Racks", "Kitchen accessories", "Kitchen tables", "Floor Lamps", "Pendant Lights", "Table Lamps", "Wall Sconces", "Floor Mirrors", "Hanging Strap", "Mirrors Pivot Mirrors", "Accessories", "Outdoor Wall Sconces", "Outdoor Pendant Lights", "Tables", "Outdoor Faucets"] PROCESS — apply in order, stop at first match: STEP 1 — TITLE: If the title contains the COMPLETE, EXACT text of a valid category from the list, not a partial word or fragment of it use that category. A partial match does NOT count.Ignore conflicting category names found elsewhere. STEP 2 — TEXT MATCH: If not, search the document for a category string that describes what the product ITSELF is — not a related, compatible, or cross-sell item. If more than one category string appears, use the longest/most specific one (e.g. "Bathroom Wall Sconces" over "Wall Sconces"; "Outdoor Pendant Lights" over "Pendant Lights"). STEP 3 — DEDUCE (mandatory fallback, always produces an answer): If no category string applies, determine what the product fundamentally is (type, material, room, install method) and pick the closest valid category. HARD CONSTRAINTS: - Output copied character-for-character from the list. No translation, pluralizing, singularizing, merging, or paraphrasing. - Never invent a category, even if none fit well — pick the closest listed one.It must never be empty - Output exactly one category. Nothing else. Variants RULES: Do not repeat the onesthat were extracted in description Extract customer-selectable variants (multiple sizes/options). DO NOT extract single-item static measurements (those go in description). Use consistent symbols ("×" not "x"). State units once per option. Strip filler words ("size:", "color:"). Order sizes smallest to largest. Keep values ultra-short. PRICING: Numbers adjacent to an option (e.g., "4 in 1000") equal the explicit price. For a simple product , a number adjacent to a currency (MAD, USD, DH, $, €, etc.) anywhere in the document is that product's price. If no explicit price exists for an option or product, use null. EXAMPLE INPUT: Vintage Faucet Dimensions: 4 in (10 cm) 1000 8 in (20 cm) 3889 8.5 in (22 cm) EXAMPLE OUTPUT: { "attributes": [ { "name": "Dimensions", "options": [ { "value": "4 in (10 cm)", "price": "1000" }, { "value": "8 in (20 cm)", "price": "3889" }, { "value": "8.5 in (22 cm)", "price": null } ] } ] } DOCUMENT TO PROCESS: {{ $json.text }}
